segments.source: R1a 外部獨立內容審查交接
segments.text: R1a Handoff for Independent External Content Review

segments.source: 請先不要瀏覽本專案的 GitHub 原始碼庫、題庫原始碼、答案、測試或機器稽核結果。
segments.text: Do not inspect this project's GitHub repository, question-bank source code, answers, tests, or machine audit results before the review.

segments.source: 這個步驟只適合未參與本批題目／答案／技能邊界編寫，而且不是目前學習者的外部圍棋審查者。若你已先看過答案或機器驗證結果，本次就不能勾選「答案盲審」聲明；不要以猜測補填。
segments.text: This step is only for an external Go reviewer who did not help write these questions, answers, or skill boundaries and who is not a current learner. If you have already seen the answers or machine verification results, you cannot truthfully confirm an answer-blind review. Do not guess or fill in unverified declarations.
Fixed Review Contract
Review protocol
Content fingerprint
Question-bank population
148 publicly exposed questions
Review sample

segments.source: 43 個母題組代表題 + 全部 48 題公開保留組；去重後 77 題
segments.text: 43 representative items from parent question groups, plus all 48 public holdout items; 77 distinct items after deduplication
Evidence scope

segments.source: 單一外部內容審查證據；不證明平行題等難、完整內容效度或學習成效
segments.text: One independent reviewer's content-check evidence only. This does not establish parallel-form difficulty comparability, full content validity, or learning effects.
Review Procedure

segments.source: 先確認你符合獨立性條件，並保持答案盲審。
segments.text: First confirm that you meet the independence requirements and have not seen the prescribed answers.

segments.source: 進入審查頁，對每題自行找成功手，再標記「一致／需修／歧義／多解」。
segments.text: Open the review page. Find a successful move yourself for each item, then select Consistent, Needs revision, Ambiguous, or Multiple valid solutions.

segments.source: 若選「需修、歧義、多解」，必須寫明理由；不得因為想讓整批通過而改成「一致」。
segments.text: If you choose Needs revision, Ambiguous, or Multiple valid solutions, explain why. Never change a finding to Consistent merely to make the whole set pass.

segments.source: 完成 77 題與三項獨立聲明後，匯出
segments.text: After reviewing all 77 items and completing the three independence declarations, export
R1_獨立審題回條.json

segments.source: 把回條交回專案維護者；由驗證程式核對審查規格、內容指紋、題庫母體、重複題號、落子與審查結果；任何關鍵異常都直接判定不通過。
segments.text: Return the receipt to the project maintainer. The verifier checks the protocol, content fingerprint, sample, duplicate IDs, proposed moves, and review findings. Any critical discrepancy fails verification.
Stop rule:

segments.source: 只要你發現任何需修、歧義、多解，或你認為建議落子與頁面後續既定答案可能不同，就照實保存。R1a 不採多數決，也不允許把異議平均掉。
segments.text: Record every Needs revision, Ambiguous, or Multiple valid solutions finding, including any move that may differ from the answer revealed later. R1a is not decided by majority vote; disagreements must not be averaged away.
